evidence: Labeled IPC; adds bitcoin-mine binary connecting to bitcoin-node over IPC, updates bitcoin wrapper, and adds end-to-end functional test for IPC mining interface.
rationale: Provides an end-to-end test executable and IPC consumer needed to exercise and unblock external mining process separation in #29432. As noted in the description, this directly serves the process separation project (#28722) by validating interfaces::Mining across the process boundary.
